title: Gaussian mixture models in Hilbert spaces via kernel methods
abstract: arXiv:2605.05996v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern datasets across many disciplines increasingly consist of time-evolving, potentially infinite-dimensional random objects, such as dynamic functional data, which are naturally modeled in Hilbert spaces. In these settings, characterizing probability measures, for example, through densities, can be ill-defined or technically challenging. Motivated by clustering applications, we propose a Gaussian mixture framework for Hilbert-space-valued data based on kernel mean embeddings and develop efficient optimization algorithms for estimation. We establish theoretical guarantees showing that the proposed algorithm is well-defined and that the model yields a dense class of approximations in infinite-dimensional spaces. We evaluate the framework through extensive experiments on diverse data geometries, including $L^2$-functional data and graph signals arising in modern medical applications.

translated_title: 基于核方法的希尔伯特空间中的高斯混合模型
translated_abstract: 现代许多学科的数据集日益由随时间演化、潜在无限维的随机对象组成，例如动态函数数据，这些数据自然地在希尔伯特空间中进行建模。在这些场景下，对概率测度进行刻画（例如通过密度函数）可能是病态定义的或在技术上具有挑战性。受聚类应用的启发，我们提出了一种基于核均值嵌入的希尔伯特空间取值数据的高斯混合框架，并开发了高效的优化算法用于估计。我们建立了理论保证，证明所提出的算法是良定义的，且该模型在无限维空间中产生稠密的近似类。我们通过对多种数据几何形态的广泛实验评估了该框架，包括 $L^2$ 函数数据以及现代医疗应用中出现的图信号。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于核均值嵌入的希尔伯特空间数据高斯混合模型框架，用于对动态函数数据等无限维随机对象进行聚类分析，并从理论和实验上证明了其良定义性、稠密近似能力以及在多种数据几何形态上的有效性。
